foodMatrices.description: Acidic citrus suspension prone to severe thermal off-flavors ('cooked cabbage' limonene oxidation) under traditional heat pasteurization, requiring gentle dense-phase CO2 micro-bubble treatment for PME stabilization.

foodMatrices.name: Cloudy Raw Apple Cider (12.8° Brix, pH 3.85)
foodMatrices.description: High-polyphenol unpasteurized apple juice subject to rapid enzymatic browning by PPO; HPCD induces carbonic acid conformation denaturation of PPO active copper sites without browning.

foodMatrices.name: Raw Bioactive Coconut Water (5.2° Brix, pH 5.25)
foodMatrices.description: Delicate low-acid electrolyte fluid requiring rapid cytoplasmic acidification by dense-phase CO2 to achieve 5-log microbial reduction while avoiding thermal pink discoloration from oxidized polyphenols.

foodMatrices.name: Liquid Whole Egg Homogenate (24.0% Solids, pH 7.40)
foodMatrices.description: High-protein colloidal matrix that coagulates at 62-64°C; HPCD achieves complete Salmonella destruction at 38°C under 160 bar without denaturing albumen or yolk functional foaming properties.

microbialTargets.inactivationMechanism: Dense CO2 membrane phospholipid extraction, cytoplasmic pH drop to <4.2, and cellular turgor lysis upon depressurization.
Carbonic acid penetration, proton pump ATPase exhaustion, irreversible loss of outer membrane lipopolysaccharide barrier.
Thick peptidoglycan wall requires sustained high dissolved CO2 activity (P > 110 bar) and shear-assisted micro-bubble penetration for membrane permeabilization.
Solubilized CO2 strips catalytic pocket hydration shell, destabilizes tertiary α-helical structure, and coordinates with Cu active sites to permanently suppress browning.

regulatoryStandards.title: Juice Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Point (HACCP) Systems
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Mandatory continuous 5-log (99.999%) reduction of the most resistant pertinent pathogen (E. coli O157:H7 or Salmonella) in commercial juice distribution.

regulatoryStandards.title: Boiler & Pressure Vessel Code (Rules for Construction of Pressure Vessels)
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Division 1 and 2 structural wall thickness, burst disc relieving capacity, and weld radiograph inspection for continuous operational pressures up to 350 bar.

regulatoryStandards.title: Standard for Low-Pressure & High-Pressure Carbon Dioxide Systems
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Ventilation, relief valve exhaust ducted outside processing facility, atmospheric CO2 sensor alarm limits (OSHA 5,000 ppm TWA, 30,000 ppm STEL).

regulatoryStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Continuous Pressure Equipment and Degassing Vessels
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Electropolished wetted contact surfaces (Ra ≤ 0.8 µm, ideally ≤ 0.38 µm), crevice-free O-ring grooves, aseptic CIP cleanability without blind corners.
